items.title: What Does Incyte (INCY) First Patient Dosing Mean For Its Colorectal Cancer Pipeline?
items.summary: Incyte (NasdaqGS: INCY) and Adagene have started first patient dosing in a Phase 1 trial combining INCA33890 with muzastotug for microsatellite stable colorectal cancer. The early stage study is testing the investigational combination in a colorectal cancer subgroup where current immunotherapy options are limited. The trial expands Incyte's gastrointestinal oncology research footprint through collaboration with Adagene on this new investigational regimen. There is more to assess with Incyte...

items.title: INCY Q3 deep dive: product diversification accelerates as R&D spending weighs on margins
items.summary: Biopharmaceutical company Incyte Corporation (NASDAQ:INCY) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14% year on year to $1.56 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $5.26 billion at the midpoint came in 11.3% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $3.60 per share was 6.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
